component.name: RavensPort
component.summary: Give each AI agent its own MCP endpoint

description.p: RavensPort is a local MCP gateway that lives in your tray and listens on 127.0.0.1. Point Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code or any other MCP client at it, and each agent gets one endpoint carrying exactly the tools you granted, from as many MCP servers and APIs as you like.

ul.li: MCP Funnel: pool several MCP servers behind one endpoint per agent, and choose which tools, resources and prompts each agent sees
API to MCP: turn a REST API into MCP tools from a JSON manifest, or import an OpenAPI spec and pick which operations become tools
OAuth2 handled: Google, GitHub, Nextcloud or any custom provider, with tokens refreshed in the background and never written into your MCP client's config

description.p: Credentials, tokens, routes and funnels are kept in a vault in 1Password or Proton Pass. This package includes the Proton Pass CLI, which RavensPort runs to reach a Proton Pass vault; it keeps the Proton Pass session key in your system keyring, so it needs one running, such as GNOME Keyring or KWallet. 1Password needs the 1Password desktop app running with SDK integration turned on.
